verdict: Organic is holding; paid is off and a GBP drop needs immediate attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, paid advertising on both Meta and Google carried zero spend, meaning all activity came entirely from organic sources. Your Google Business Profile delivered 142 actions in the period — 48 calls and 94 website clicks — but GBP engagement collapsed 98% week-over-week, with three consecutive days of zero activity through August 28; this is being investigated now as a priority. On the positive side, search clicks rose 4.4% and website sessions grew 14% over the most recent seven days, confirming that organic search interest remains intact. Separately, 24 contacts came in over the period but produced zero opportunities in the pipeline, pointing to a gap in how inquiries are being captured and followed up — SMS automation and intake tracking are being activated by August 31 to close that gap. Once the contract extension is in place, paid campaigns will restart and the full channel mix will be back online.

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement dropped to zero over the last three days, a confirmed issue that is cutting into calls and clicks.
watch_item.fix: The profile is being audited immediately for a listing issue or suspension, and a consistent posting cadence is being reinstated by September 30.
